# sprint organization roles reorder

Package: `@hyungjuk/sprint` · Version: `1.1.0`

[CLI index](../../../README.md) · [Parent](../roles.md)

## Help

```text
NAME
  sprint organization roles reorder — reorder native organization record; server constraints and permissions apply

SYNOPSIS
  sprint organization roles reorder --json-data OBJECT | --file PATH [FLAGS]

DESCRIPTION
  reorder native organization record; server constraints and permissions apply

EXAMPLES
  sprint organization roles reorder --file input.json

POSITIONAL ARGUMENTS
  None; see SYNOPSIS for required input flags.

FLAGS
  --json-data OBJECT | --file PATH

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                 Show command help without authentication or network.
  --schema [DOMAIN]          Print API action contracts as JSON; not CLI flag syntax.
  --llms [DOMAIN]            AI guide; DOMAIN selects action-contract JSON.
  --profile NAME             Select a private Sprint profile (default: default).
  --token-file FILE          Use an owned mode 0600 automation-token JSON file.
  --non-interactive          Never prompt; startup auto-update is skipped.
  --wait                     Observe an accepted job without retrying the mutation.
  --timeout SECONDS          Wait timeout, 1..3600; requires --wait (default: 30).

OUTPUT
  output {records} on stdout; errors on stderr.

AUTHENTICATION
  Sprint profile or automation-token file required. Server permissions are authoritative.

NOTES
  Examples use placeholder IDs and files; replace them with authorized current values.
  Organization commands use full native management DTOs, distinct from root members/teams metadata {id,name}. Lists and role reorder return {records} without pagination. No query/revision/operation-key flags; only members list supports --graduated. Member delete is unavailable: use graduation-precheck, graduate with explicit date/reason, and restore (also cancels a future schedule). Updates assign organization fields; name/email are creation-only. Reorder payload is exactly {ids:[all current IDs]}, scoped to roles or team-roles. Memberships replace the nonempty set; job functions must belong to each selected team. Classification never grants account permissions. Server permissions/validation are authoritative; HTTP 400 retains shared exit 7, local argument errors exit 64, conflicts 9 and forbidden 8. Native endpoints do not offer revision or idempotency guarantees; no automatic retries.
  JSON payload: {"ids":"complete ordered ID array; CLI adds fixed kind from namespace"}

SEE ALSO
  sprint help organization roles
  sprint topic output
  Documentation: https://github.com/Hyungjuk42/sprint-docs/blob/main/cli/reference/organization/roles/reorder.md
```
